display_name: LoRa W24 等能量局部频点／chirp 方向对照（Full）
description: Compare equal parameter local frequency and chirp directions in the actually deployed half-edit. Preserve absolute band 9–32 energy, all other bins and edge IQ.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native split 392005. One 1536/128 disjoint unlabeled source fit/holdout. Same frozen 300-source physical IDs and prior direct/outer parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed outer parent. Two matched 5698-real-parameter residual MLPs; identical seed and zero last layer for parent reproduction.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Contract-bound LoRa U_s frozen parent; U_s IQ only for new coefficients. W24 for frozen source inference.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze checkpoint at 384 steps. Candidate frequency arm requires parent+18 six, parent+10 low, clean at least direct, and positive six/low over matched chirp arm to advance.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU, 3 then 7, 0, 6; >=12 GiB free and existing remote process cap. 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on data/contract, archived actual controls, shape or finite-number failure, missing views, failing real no-query smoke or independent truth-last.

rows.method: Frozen W24 direct/outer half, two matched 3-slot context MLPs with neighbors along chirp or within a frequency sideband. Actual band edit normalized to parent norm.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 384 AdamW steps per arm, batch 48 and shared sampled rows. 1536 U_s train and 128 U_s holdout with one generic paired and one clean view, 300 source V x seven views.

notes: One scope: the 9–32 signed frequency bins of the actual half-edit, held at original per-packet band norm.
Both heads use the same center features and MLP widths; only observed adjacency axis differs. Each signed sideband and chirp train edge uses index repetition.
U_s direction loss uses clean-minus-disturbed true source difference only in same-waveform generic pairs. Identity pairs target the parent direction at twice the loss weight. No F or target accesses.
No target path in this source screen. Complete source Full guards, independent P0/P1 and proof from source archive.
